The Event Loop Mechanism

The event loop monitors the Call Stack and the Task Queues. When the Call Stack is empty, it pushes the first task from the queue onto the stack.

ES2024+ Native Implementation

const connectionPool = new Set([101, 102, 103]);
const activeSockets = new Set([102, 104]);
const intersection = connectionPool.intersection(activeSockets);
console.log(intersection); // Output: Set(1) { 102 }
